summary: Row-wise adaptive-filter dispatcher (cdecl). Applies one of four predictor modes, selected by a5, to a byte row a3 using the predictor row a4 and a row descriptor a2 whose +4 field holds the byte count and whose +11 field holds the bit depth (bytes-per-pixel = (depth+7)>>3). Modes: 1 extends the leading block across the row, 2 adds the predictor, 3 averages, 4 applies a three-sample minimizer. Unrecognized modes report 'Ignoring bad adaptive filter type' through CallbackDispatch and zero the first output byte.

operations.description: Dispatch guard: if a5 (filter mode) is nonzero the function enters a switch over the four adaptive-filter cases; when a5 is zero the buffers are left untouched and the function returns zero.

Case 1 (extend leading block): with byte-depth offset off=(*(a2+11)+7)>>3 and row length len=*(a2+4), copy-add the first off bytes of a3 onto the trailing len-off bytes (a3[i+off] += a3[i]), duplicating the first block across the rest of the row.
Case 2 (add predictor): for i in 0..len-1 over *(a2+4) bytes, accumulate the predictor row: a3[i] += a4[i].
Case 3 (average predictor): for the first off bytes add a3[i] += a4[i]>>1; for the remaining bytes add a3[i] += (a4[i] + a3[i-off])/2.

Case 4 (three-sample minimizer): for the first off bytes add a3[i] += a4[i]; for the remaining bytes select the sample among a3[i], a4[i], a4[i+1] that minimizes a pair-difference metric and accumulate it into a3[i].
Default case (invalid filter type): guard that routes unrecognized modes to the error path.
Call CallbackDispatch(a1, aIgnoringBadAda) with the 'Ignoring bad adaptive filter type' message string on the invalid-mode path.
On the invalid-mode path, zero the first destination byte: *a3 = 0.
Return the byte value accumulated in v5 (zero on the invalid-mode path and when a5 is zero).
Invoked by sub_511B7C (0x00511B7C) as the row adaptive-filter stage.
